scholarships.title: Camoes, I.P. Portuguese Language and Culture Scholarships
scholarships.official_source: Camões - Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Portugal)

existing.description: Camões - Instituto da Cooperação e da Língua, I.P., the Portuguese Ministry of Foreign Affairs agency for external language and culture cooperation, runs a set of scholarship programmes within the Portuguese Language and Culture Scholarship Programme. The programmes support improvement of language skills, study and research in Portuguese language and culture, scientific or professional training of Portuguese as a Second Language, and training in translation and conference interpreting. They are financed by State Budget funds allocated to Camões, I.P./Ministry of Foreign Affairs and, where eligible, by funds from the Enterprise for the Promotion of the Portuguese Language (EPLP).
eligibility: Course scholarships (Summer and Annual): foreign students and Portuguese citizens living abroad seeking to improve their Portuguese language skills

Fernão Mendes Pinto Programme: foreign and Portuguese students who are graduates or in their final year of undergraduate study, involved in scientific or professional training projects in the area of Portuguese as a Foreign Language

Research Programme: teachers and researchers, foreign nationals and Portuguese living abroad, undertaking master's or PhD specialisation studies in Portuguese language and culture at Portuguese universities
Pessoa Programme: holders of a Chair in Portuguese Studies or in Portuguese Departments at foreign universities or research institutes
Vieira Programme: foreign and Portuguese graduates living abroad involved in training or improvement projects in translation and conference interpreting
existing.eligibility_summary: Course scholarships are aimed at 'foreign students and Portuguese citizens living abroad who wish to improve their language skills'. The Fernão Mendes Pinto Programme is for foreign and Portuguese students who are graduates or in their final year of undergraduate study and are involved in scientific or professional training projects in Portuguese as a Foreign Language. The Research Programme is for teachers and researchers, foreign or Portuguese living abroad, undertaking specialisation studies including master's and PhD programmes at Portuguese universities.
benefits: Attendance at Portuguese language and culture summer courses (one month)
Attendance at Portuguese language and culture annual courses (eight months)
Renewable research and training grants of variable duration
Support for translation and conference interpreting training (Vieira Programme)
coverage: Tuition and fees for Portuguese language and culture courses at Portuguese universities or institutes recognised by Camões, I.P. (course scholarships)
Financial support for specialisation studies, including master's and PhD study programmes at Portuguese universities (Research Programme)
Support for training and research projects in the field of Portuguese language and culture (Fernão Mendes Pinto, Pessoa programmes)
requirements: Applications are submitted in two phases: an online pre-application form, then, for candidates selected after the first triage, submission of documentation by email for the final decision
Application forms are completed on the Camões, I.P. site; the application process begins in March of each year for some programmes
application_method: Two-phase process: 1st stage (Pre-application) - correctly complete the respective online forms; 2nd stage (Application) - candidates selected after the first triage are contacted by email to send the documentation needed for the final decision
Applications are submitted through the Camões, I.P. online forms for each programme call
existing.best_fit: Researchers and professionals in Portuguese language, culture, translation studies
existing.duration: Annual Course scholarships last eight months and are not renewable; Summer Course scholarships last one month; the Fernão Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira programmes have a variable duration and may be renewed.
existing.application_period: Annual. For the 2026 cycle all six programme calls ran 5 to 18 May 2026 (until 17:00, Lisbon time); the 2026 calls closed and provisional lists were published in May-June 2026.
existing.deadline_display: The 2026 application window ran 5 to 18 May 2026 (until 17:00, Lisbon time); the 2027 call had not been published when this record was verified on 2026-10-04.
existing.program_type: Government-funded language and culture scholarship programme (Ministry of Foreign Affairs budget)
